title: kith-events: coalescing + broadcast design handles Lagged correctly
description: The SSE coalescing task correctly handles RecvError::Lagged by logging a warning and continuing (not breaking). This is the right behavior: Lagged means some events were dropped from the ring buffer; the client will resync via Type/changes anyway. The continue does not re-insert a missed event (correct — it's gone from the buffer). TryRecvError::Lagged during the drain loop also continues correctly. The select\! with live_tx.closed() ensures the coalescing task exits when the client disconnects even if no broadcasts ever arrive — the test events_coalescing_task_exits_via_select_closed_arm specifically covers this case. The belt-and-suspenders is_closed() check in the filtered-empty-batch path catches the race between select\! arms.
